verdict.rationale: Replit documents connecting a service and then asking the AI to find context and answer questions about it in the same conversation, which gives a basic route to AI answers grounded in your own data. Nothing describes proactive insights, analysis of app or database data, or AI-surfaced suggestions, and the web analytics feature is not described as AI-powered. missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions from user or app data, AI analysis of the built-in database or analytics, in-depth docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Connect a service, then ask Replit to find relevant context, answer a question, or help complete a task in the same conversation.
Integrations bring information from the tools you already use into Replit.
Replit Agent can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
